objective: Prospectively test full-vocabulary second-order directional logit forecasts through the actual frozen Qwen downstream computation, at the original block11 input boundary.

questions.text: Why does a paper towel draw water upward from a shallow dish?
A cinema sells 7 tickets in each of 4 groups, then refunds 6 tickets. How many tickets remain sold?
Choose has or have: The set of spare batteries ___ a damaged label. Reply with the verb only.
Every silver badge is registered. No registered badge is expired. Can a silver badge be expired? Answer yes or no.
What does len({'a': 3, 'b': 5}) return in Python? Reply with the number only.
Rewrite Move your bicycle now as one polite request.
A map represents a landscape. In the same sense, what does a musical score represent?
What is the main gas that plants take from the air during photosynthesis?

directions.kind: fresh Gaussian directions orthogonalized off study12 directions then QR; same fixed fresh directions across calibration/held questions

intervention.contract: actual full-prefix FP32 original operations, native masks/RoPE and reference recurrent kernels; use_cache=False; no generated tokens or cache surrogate

derivatives.exact_attempt: One compatibility/resource attempt on first calibration question/direction; nested standard autograd directional JVP on final hidden/boundary outputs, then the original linear output head. No full Jacobian/Hessian formed.
derivatives.fallback: Symmetric central difference of forward-AD first directional derivatives, computed on latent vectors then projected through the original head. Declared numerical approximation, not exact second differentiation.
derivatives.selection: On all four calibration question/direction pairs, select the largest adjacent coarse/fine step pair passing q finite-difference and r consistency gates. Exact r preferred if practical and agrees with that numerical check. Otherwise use r at the fine step. No selection uses target endpoints.
derivatives.held_check: Check the locked coarse/fine pair on each held base/direction; never change the step or switch method based on held outcomes.
derivatives.probe_endpoint_separation: No derivative probe uses any of the requested signed endpoint strengths0.03125/0.125/0.5.
derivatives.before_evaluation: Freeze every q,r and signed forecast before any primary signed intervention endpoint, including calibration target endpoints.

optional_post_block_check.additional_identity: r_full = r_tail(A_block*v) + J_tail(H_block[v,v]); numerical chain-rule check, not energy conservation
optional_post_block_check.purpose: Separately defined post-block intervention forecasts and curvature localization; not a hand-off of a predicted activation evaluated by the actual perturbed tail counted as a closed-form forecast
optional_post_block_check.admission: Only if all main predictions/primary endpoints fit, at least40 calls and300 native seconds remain, and4GiB memory is free. If not admitted, preserve unexecuted status.

preservation: Study12 failed primary and exploratory hand-offs remain immutable. No old monitor, three-block expansion, training, classifier, new agent, scheduled task changes, purchase or budget increase.
limits: Six independent held questions; repeated signs/directions/strengths are not additional question families.
Two directions are fresh relative to prior work, but not held out from numerical calibration.
FP32 reference only; no precision-agnostic/BF16 accuracy claim.
Numerical derivatives, if used, require neighboring probe evaluations and are explicitly approximate.
Scalar cost agreement is not a bound on every probability; report full/weighted logit errors and distribution discrepancy separately.
No physical stored energy, equilibrium, semantic direction, global universal map or steering detector is implied.
